sections.Profile:
"Sunshine," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1958, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. The playfield features two flippers, five bumpers, and three gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
